openQuestions: Q1 Curfew: move towns.curfew with the pass-out (whisper 25.5 = 01:30, night watch 25.75 = 01:45; DEFAULT) or keep 23.5 / 23.75 (the towns go quiet at 23:45, the two new hours exist only on the farm)?

Q2 Do shops or stalls stay open after midnight (the inn on Friday and Saturday, Natteblik 20-25.5)? DEFAULT: no, every shipped close stays <= 23:30; the exact data lines are in CLOCK_26_ADDENDUM.md section 9.2 when the user says yes. (The ghost family's lantern house 17-25 is the family design's own question, its Q1 in design6/family/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, default yes, one number.)

Q3 Festivals: keep every window ending by 23:00 (DEFAULT) or let Midsommerlanterne / Årsskiftet run past midnight (Årsskiftet 15-25 with a true-midnight toast needs a NEW game_event, never midnight_passed)?

Q4 An autosave taken at the 02:00 roll resumes awake at 02:00 of the new date (the 00:00 roll did the same). DEFAULT: leave it. Alternative: lift every saved hour below 06:00 to 06:00 on load (one line in GameManager.from_dict).

Q5 Confirm the display: the clock reads 00:30 and 01:30 while the date block still says "Tirsdag 16." until the 02:00 roll (the user's rule: the hours 24 and 25 belong to the same game day). DEFAULT: yes.

Q6 Confirm the rate: minutes_per_real_second stays 2.0, so the day is 10 real minutes (a game hour = 30 real seconds, +11 % per day). Alternative 2.222 keeps 9 minutes but changes every "game minutes = real seconds" figure of the towns, social and ghost designs. DEFAULT: keep 2.0.

Q7 Optional bedtime nudge: one whisper at 01:30 ("Det er sent. Gå i seng, før du falder om.", one new key WHISPER_SLEEPY in world.csv, 10 lines in D0). DEFAULT: no (the pass-out toast already says it, and the player loses nothing).
